name: Kubernetes
suggestedProbes: Walk me through a CrashLoopBackOff you debugged in production — what was the root cause?
Operators / CRDs — have you authored one, or just consumed third-party operators?
RBAC — who manages cluster-level permissions in your shop, and what's the boundary between app teams and platform team?
Network policies — turned on by default in your clusters, or opt-in per workload?
guidanceForUnknownVersion: Yellow — version matters for security and features.
checklistGuidance: Round-12 hybrid mode (Sven round-7 + Lars rounds 9-10): the services axis captures depth-of-operation independent from version era. Helm-consumers tick 3-5 services (workloads / config / autoscaling). Platform engineers tick 9-12 (everything except possibly multi-cluster if single-cluster shop). The Yellow band (25-66% coverage) is honest mid-territory — operators who know their workloads but haven't owned cluster-build.

name: AWS (Amazon Web Services)

checklistGuidance: AWS spans dozens of services. Coverage of core compute + storage + DB + IAM tells you whether they have real production exposure or just touched one corner. Round-4: architect-shaped (Landing Zone / Organizations / IAM Identity Center), security-shaped (KMS / Macie / GuardDuty / Security Hub / Inspector), CI/CD-shaped (CodeBuild / CodePipeline), and data-ML-shaped (SageMaker / Bedrock) services added; templates surface different subsets via `serviceTagFilters`.
